metrics_finding.finding: inventory-service experienced a significant increase in CPU utilization and mean latency during the failure window, while memory utilization remained relatively stable.

evidence_summary.summary: Inventory service experienced a significant increase in CPU utilization and mean latency during the failure window, while memory utilization remained relatively stable.

report.suggested_fix: Investigate and optimize inventory-service for high CPU utilization and mean latency.

report_text.en: The root cause of the incident is believed to be a high CPU utilization and mean latency in the inventory service. Further investigation is required to confirm this finding.
report_text.hi: अप्रत्याशित घटना के मुख्य कारण संभवतः इन्वेंट्री सेवा में उच्च CPU उपयोग और औसत लेटेंसी है। अतिरिक्त जांच आवश्यक है ताकि यह पाया जा सके.
